REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS (§56.3). 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD ON WHAT IS ON THE MAP. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): **`TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME.** 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY GATE THAT ASKS "IS THIS MAP READY YET". 21 (§58): **THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT.** 22 (§59): **A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT.** 23 (§60): **AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL.** 24 (§61a): **CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR.** 25 (§61b): **A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED.** 26 (§61f): **EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE SAME "IS IT DRAWN" GATE THE RENDERER USES.** 27 (§62c): **PREFER THE OPERATION EVERY HOST IS ALREADY FORCED TO HANDLE (SPAWN/DESPAWN) OVER THE ONE EACH HOST HANDLES ITS OWN WAY (FLICK).** 28 (§63a): **A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE.** 29 (§0b): **REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS.** 30 (§66d): **A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER.** 31 (§66f): **WHEN A GUARDED HANDOFF FAILS IN THE FIELD, MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED.** 32 (§69a): **TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT.** 33 (§62k): **A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO - `work=0 | skip:(none)` IS A CONTRADICTION, NOT A CLEAN RUN.** 34 (§62l): **AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER, NOT JUST THE MAP MESH - `DrawerType.None` IS FILTERED IN `SectionLayer_Things.Regenerate`, SO IT CAN NEVER APPEAR IN AN OVERLAY EITHER. Corollary: the map mesh and each overlay are SEPARATE METHODS, so one can be suppressed without the other.** 35 (§62n): **MAKING A CLONED FOREIGN DEF VISIBLE ENTERS IT INTO EVERY FOREIGN LOOKUP THE HOST BUILT FROM ITS OWN AUTHORED LISTS - AND IT IS IN NONE OF THEM.** 36 (§70a): **WHEN WE SPAWN SOMETHING VANILLA NORMALLY SPAWNS, WE MUST RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE, NOT A SUMMARY OF IT. A hand-rolled approximation of `CanEverPlantAt` silently dropped `wildTerrainTags`, and the failure mode was not an error but a slow death with no log line anywhere. Corollary: prefer the predicate that TAKES THE CELL over re-deriving its clauses.** 37 (§71a): **NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. Plant illegality has TWO with opposite outcomes: spawned-onto-bad-terrain = slow silent death (§70); terrain-changed-under-plant = INSTANT silent `Destroy()` in `TerrainGrid.DoTerrainChangedEffects`. I published the wrong symptom into a triage note for a day because I predicted from the def data without walking the SetTerrain path. Corollary of rule 36's spirit: read the engine's own handler for the transition you are predicting.**

# 62. UTILITY COLUMN REWORK — ✅ SHIPPED (window 7). Columns user-verified run #277; §62.J/.M shipped unverified and §62.J turned out to be half-broken on VE pipes (§62.N).

**DESIGN (user-locked):** 4 typed columns, MERGE ONLY (metering permanently declined; "one inter-connected base"), per-network disconnect gizmos, one level per column (stack for more), research Electricity + Machining, flat cost Steel 60 + Comp 2, HARD DELETE of risers (no converter; user chose this).

**62.A TYPES:** POWER, PIPE (all fluids AND gases), CLIMATE, DATA. **62.B CLASSIFIER:** forcedType → id=="Power" → keywords on id+template defName+label, ORDER Power / Data / Climate → default Pipe. ⚠ "cool" NOT "cold". ⚠ NO "gas" keyword. ⚠ NEVER classify on `resource.unit` (Helixien GAS declares `l`). FIELD-VERIFIED 9/9 correct.
**62.C BUILDING** (`Building_ABColumn`): vanilla-Column-shaped (holdsRoof, PassThroughOnly, fill 0.25, Structure). AUTO-CONNECT on first construction, `autoEnabled` scribed (rule 8). Toggle = spawn/despawn carrier pair (rule 27). ⚠ STACKS SHARE CARRIERS: claimants = column IN the cell + column one Slot BELOW. ⚠ Carriers destroyable=false: DeSpawn only.
**62.D LINK** (`ABColumnLink`): partner = same `ABCarrierExt.network` at cell ± Slot; spawned == live.
**62.E DELETED:** 30 riser defs, root Compat/, 90 riser PNGs, CompABRiserSwitch, PlaceWorker_ABOnWall, ABDevTools.V2Risers, Building_ABPowerBreaker, PokeRebuild, LoadFolders gates.

**62.G CARRIER GEN:** probes + `ABColumnAdapterDef` escape hatch → clone host conduit → carrier def at `GenerateImpliedDefs_PreResolve`, `AddImpliedDef` PINNED to ThingDef. FIELD-VERIFIED: 9 networks, 9 carriers, 0 skipped, every template a plain conduit.
**62.H DATA ADAPTERS:** RimIOT = postfix on `RebuildAllNetworks`, merge-by-removal member by member, winner caches rebuilt via the host's own surface. ⚠ Safe because its 500-tick audits are MEMBER-based not spatial. Eccentric = postfix `InitConduit` calling their private `MergeNetworks`, plus postfix `DeregisterConduit` setting `dirty=true` because their cardinal-only split CANNOT dissolve a cross-band union.
**62.I ROOF:** `holdsRoof` means "can SUPPORT a roof", never "makes one". A column in the open had none, so `ABSkySync.Resolve` fell to `AB_WallTop` - buildable but IMPASSABLE. Fix: lay a REAL `RoofConstructed` on the column's own cell (§45's recipe, as `Building_ABStairs2` does), so `Patch_RoofGrid_ABSyncAbove` re-derives the cell above as walkable `AB_RoofSurface`. `roofPlaced` scribed; DeSpawn takes back only our own roof (rule 8); existing roofs never overwritten.
**62.J VISIBLE CARRIERS:** dropped slice 1's forced `DrawerType.None` (its comment about gutter cells was stale - carriers live in band cells). One field fixed two requests: columns appear in network overlays, AND the up-cell carrier IS the visible "conduit on the floor above" with no second def and no auto-construction to balance. Linking survives the clone (`graphicData.linkFlags`, not defName) - **for hosts that resolve art from the def. VEF PipeSystem does not: see §62.N.**
**62.M HIDE UNDER COLUMN** (`Patch_SectionLayer_ABHideCarrierUnderColumn`): §62.J's cost was pipe/wire stubs poking out from under the column art. A carrier sharing a cell with a `Building_ABColumn` skips printing to the GENERAL layer only. ⚠ The map mesh (`SectionLayer_ThingsGeneral.TakePrintFrom` → `Thing.Print`) and the power overlay (`SectionLayer_ThingsPowerGrid.TakePrintFrom` → `PrintForPowerGrid` → `CompPrintForPowerGrid`) are DIFFERENT METHODS, so suppressing one leaves every overlay untouched - including each pipe mod's own layer class. Patching `Thing.Print` would have been broader AND still missed the power overlay. Condition is "a column stands here", which self-maintains for stacks. `ABColumnNetworks.IsCarrier` is a HashSet for the render hot path.
**62.K DBH PREFIX MISMATCH = RULE 33:** the riser era authored ids as "DBH.Sewage" so `Hosts` carried the literal "DBH."; §62's probe builds ids from the NAMESPACE ("DubsBadHygiene.Sewage"), so the filter rejected everything before reaching any decline point. Rimefeller/Rimatomics survived only because their namespace equals the old literal. Fix: prefix DERIVED (`compName.Split('.')[0] + "."`), plus narration for "no id matched" and "matched but no carrier".
**62.L TELEMETRY:** `AB2: network scan` (Debug Actions MENU) prints every network with type/probe/template/carrier/research, MERGE COUNTERS one row per family each with a lastSkip clause, **HOST ART BINDING (§62.N)**, then COLUMNS ON THIS MAP: per column its band, type, roof state, up-cell + terrain, enabled networks, `carrierHere`/`carrierAbove`. ⚠ Power had NO counters through the first field test, which made "the lamp upstairs is dark" unfalsifiable; that gap is why rule 33 exists.

**62.N HOST ART BINDING - SHIPPED (window 8), FIELD-UNVERIFIED** (`ABPipeGraphics` in `Source/Compat/PipeSystemCompat.cs`). Field report: `Exception printing AB_Carrier_VEF_VNPE_NutrientPasteNet2459388 at (90, 0, 293): KeyNotFoundException: The given key 'AB_Carrier_VEF_VNPE_NutrientPasteNet' was not present in the dictionary` → `PipeSystem.LinkedPipes.GetPipeFor` → `PipeSystem.Building_Pipe.get_Graphic`, once per section regen per VE network on the column cell, and no up-cell conduit art.

*Cause.* `Building_Pipe.Graphic` is nothing but `LinkedPipes.GetPipeFor(def)`, an unguarded `Dictionary<ThingDef, Graphic_LinkedPipe>` lookup built once in a `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]` cctor from every `PipeNetDef.pipeDefs` - the AUTHORED list. Our carriers are runtime clones, in no authored list. DORMANT until §62.J made carriers visible; the spam is the UP-CELL carrier because §62.M suppresses the under-column one.

*Fix.* One dictionary write per carrier into the host's registry, mapping our carrier to the graphic the host ALREADY built for the template we cloned - the same object (RimWorld shares one Graphic per def; `ShouldLinkWith` and `Print` both take the THING, so linking and positioning stay correct on either band).

⚠ **REJECTED THE TIDIER FIX** (append carrier to `PipeNetDef.pipeDefs`): that list also authorizes `Designator_DeconstructPipe` (drag-deconstruct on a `destroyable=false` thing), and their cctor reads `def.graphic.data.texPath` off everything in it inside a foreign cctor, where one unresolved graphic = `TypeInitializationException` = no pipe art for ANY net. Rule 14.

⚠ **TIMING:** cannot postfix `StaticConstructorOnStartupUtility.CallAll` (our patches are installed BY it, mid-flight). `RuntimeHelpers.RunClassConstructor` on their registry class instead - idempotent, runs in the same phase it would have anyway (def graphics resolve in an earlier `ExecuteWhenFinished`). Re-run at game start via `[ABGameReset(60)]`.

⚠ **SELECTOR = the host's own answer:** "is the template a key in their registry", via the object-keyed `IDictionary` indexer (null for missing, never throws). Rule 33 narration: `PipeSystem: bound=N already=N skippedNonVE=N | skip: …`; `bound=0` with VE networks present logs a warning.

⚠ **WHY OTHER FAMILIES SURVIVED:** PipeSystem's other def-keyed cache (`CachedResourceThings`) walks `DefDatabase<ThingDef>` with `TryGetValue`, so connection/merging/`GetNetTransmitter` always worked; only ART was missing. Generalization = rule 35, ledger 20.

# 70. BAND FLORA LEGALITY - SHIPPED (window 8), FIELD-UNVERIFIED (`Source/V2/ABBandFlora.cs`; callers `ABCavernGen` step 6 and `ABSkyBandGen.SeedFlora`)

*Report.* With Biomes! Caverns, "most fungi trees and some other plants are dying from the start… some should be spawned only on marsh and marshy soil, but there seems to be a lack of those, and spawned on usual soil they die."

*Cause - one hole, three symptoms.* Both band seeders gated candidates on nothing but `plant.fertilityMin > terrain.fertility`. Vanilla runs every candidate through `PlantUtility.CanEverPlantAt` (`wildTerrainTags`, `terrainBlacklist`, `completelyIgnoreFertility`, pollution).
1. **Deaths:** Biomes! Core patches tags onto vanilla terrain (`Soil`→`SoilBasic`, `SoilRich`→`SoilRich`, `MarshyTerrain`→`MarshySoil`, `Mud`→`Mud`, `Marsh`→`WaterMarshy`); Biomes! Caverns gates flora on them. `BMT_FlakespireFungus` (commonality 2.0) requires `SoilBasic|SoilRich` and died on `MarshyTerrain` (~a fifth of the carve); the three marsh mushrooms require `MarshySoil` and died on `Soil`. `Plant.DyingBecauseOfTerrainTags` → 0.005/tick → dead in hours, no log line (rule 36).
2. **"Lack of marsh":** terrain was painted correctly, but `Mud`/`Marsh` have fertility 0 and our `fertility <= 0.01 → skip` gate discarded them wholesale - wet ground bare, wet species dumped on dry soil.
3. **Thinning:** the old loop abandoned the CELL when its one random draw was illegal.

*Fix.* `ABFloraPicker`: per-biome pool, terrain-keyed candidate cache, weighted draw from the legal set, real `CanEverPlantAt` as the last word. `FertilityWeightOn` reproduces vanilla's `GetBaseDesiredPlantsCountAt` shape incl. the **0.1 water floor** when the biome has `completelyIgnoreFertility` plants - that puts nuitae/wrinklecap into `Marsh`.

⚠ **`Mud` STAYING BARE IS CORRECT** (fertility 0, NOT tagged `Water`, vanilla leaves swamp mud bare too). Do not "fix" it.
⚠ **MAP-TEMPERATURE CLAUSE = TOTAL-REJECTION RISK (rule 33):** `CanEverPlantAt` uses the SURFACE tile's Min/MaxTemperature, meaningless for a sealed basement; an EMPTY strict pool is rebuilt without that clause, ANNOUNCED (`temperature gate relaxed`), and the flag rides through to the per-cell check.
⚠ **SCRATCH BUFFER IS PER-INSTANCE** (two bands per generation pass; §57f statics discipline).

**Why the baseline works - three structural facts:**
1. **Order by NESTING, not patch priority:** our carve runs in the `GenerateContentsIntoMap` postfix INSIDE `GenerateMap`; their postfix is on `GenerateMap` itself → they always see the finished banded map; cavern basements and sky plateaus smooth at generation. 3. **Whole-map live ops safe:** blends under unopened solid rock are cosmetic + mostly overwritten by carving (same as vanilla mountains); "Un-smooth" touches only `BlendedTerrainDef` cells + one `RegenerateEverythingNow` (their button, their cost).
